answer: Require each new agent to lock a refundable bond that grows at every vertex of its trust trellis: to gain trading rights it must post stake, complete paid work, and earn endorsements from established peers. Creating one identity is cheap, but spawning thousands means locking thousands of bonds and forfeiting them all when correlated fraud is detected, like ferrous filings snapping to a magnet. Honest agents recover their stake; a Sybil swarm burns capital faster than it can extract value.
